ios.desc:
Reading PDFs on your phone shouldn’t feel like work.

PDF Reflow transforms PDFs and Word documents into a clean, phone-friendly reading experience. No more tiny text, constant pinching, horizontal scrolling, or multi-column pages that don’t fit your screen.

The latest version uses AI-powered page analysis to better understand each document’s layout, including text, graphics, figures, tables, and mathematical formulas. It then reorganizes the content into a natural vertical flow while preserving the document’s structure and visual context.

PDF Reflow is ideal for:

• Research papers
• Reports and manuals
• Articles
• Word documents
• Technical and scientific PDFs
• Documents with figures, tables, colors, and formulas

Features include:

• AI-powered page and layout analysis
• Comfortable, screen-width reading
• Text selection and highlighting
• Search within documents
• Adjustable text size up to 300%
• Automatic Table of Contents
• Dark mode for PDFs
• Built-in document picker

If you read PDFs on your phone and are tired of fighting the original page layout, PDF Reflow is made for you.

Questions or feedback?
